balloons.text: Next morning. Tenth round complete.
They will still be there when you have put your money away.
I have the request. I still do not know the door.
SeraThen we look before we promise.
Stay on the dry side, please.
You asked about first-bell collection. This is Aren, and Sera came to see the approach.
EddaFirst bell is when this doorway is clear.
Second bell.
The tubs keep moving through second bell. I cannot stop the wash floor for a cart.
First bell is my Lower Post round. I cannot take that time.
Then why did you come?
ArenBecause we had not looked at the door.
EddaGood. Look before you quote me.
These are ours. Two small bundles, dry and tied. We can try with them.
DaroThe wheel stays out. That sill has a job.
I can carry one through by hand.
SeraWe should see whether the doorway stays clear while you do.
One out-and-back trial, as far as the trough. Both bundles come back to this bench.
EddaI will pay each of you for the trial, even if we stop at the door.
DaroI can do one trial now. The packing yard has me after third bell.
ArenIf the route does not work, we bring it back.
Use the morning as it is. Do not clear it for us.
Wait. I am taking your doorway.
That is what I meant by first bell.
ArenYou needed the doorway back. Not an earlier cart.
Does that one open onto the dry bench?
We use it for mending. A collection basket will not fit.
DaroThese wraps will. The cart stays out here.
If the wash floor keeps moving, I do not need you at first bell.
Beside the first. Keep the handle side clear.
Enough room to stop and let someone past.
Dry. Both back. And the floor never stopped.
Use this hatch when we agree a collection. Do not leave a stack outside for me to find.
After the post, between second and third bell. Only small, dry bundles like these.
EddaAnd I hand them over. Nothing waiting in the street.
DaroAsk where the load is going before you put my cart in the plan.
ArenDoor, load and your hours. Then a price.
Dry hatch. Two bundles. One forecourt trial.
SeraThat is what we have seen.
For your time. The stopped attempt counted too.
And yours.
Next time, knock here before you bring anything.
ArenWe will ask about the load first.
I nearly said first bell just to keep her listening.
DaroShe listened when you stopped guessing about her morning.
I have my next job. Ask me before you accept the next load.
ArenI will.
You stopped the first method before it stopped her work.
ArenI still want to take the route assessment I missed.
SeraAsk for the hours and the load. I can say what I saw; the assessor decides what is tested.
ArenTomorrow after the post. I ask before I commit.
I want to know which part I am ready for.
SeraThen that is the question we take.
